description: Joron wears a long burgundy-purple tailored outer coat with narrow gold patterned borders along the open front, cuffs and lower edge. Beneath it is a cream ankle-length tunic with a small slit neckline, fine gold-brown embroidered edging and a narrow decorated hem. A broad patterned belt has a round metal buckle and two tasseled hanging ends. Dark brown trousers and tall brown leather-like boots cover the legs. The sleeves reach the wrists, with small cream cuffs. A small ring is visible. Fabrics appear woven with a slightly plush outer-coat surface, but exact fibers cannot be established. The outfit is opaque and no headgear, armor or weapon is present.
